properties.title: Denso Revises Profit Forecast Amid Trade Tensions
properties.summary: Denso has announced a significant downward revision of its full-year operating profit forecast, now projecting a net profit of 4,200 billion yen, down from 4,970 billion yen. This adjustment comes in response to ongoing international trade tensions and increased costs due to U.S. tariffs, which have severely impacted the company's profitability.

properties.title: AI-Powered Fire Alert System Developed in Hokkaido
properties.summary: Hokkaido University startup AWL and Denso Hokkaido are collaborating to create an innovative AI-powered system designed to alert factories of potential fire hazards. This development aims to enhance safety measures in industrial settings, leveraging advanced technology to prevent disasters.

properties.title: Denso's Pianodardine Plant Faces Job Uncertainty Amid Layoff Controversy
properties.summary: Denso faces renewed employment uncertainty at its Pianodardine plant following unrest over layoffs, with the first tranche of welfare support set to expire soon. The company plans to resume production by the end of December but warns that around 200 jobs remain at risk, potentially leading to further layoffs. Denso is prepared to reapply for government support if necessary, highlighting ongoing challenges in the automotive sector.

properties.title: Denso Thermal Systems Faces Major Layoffs Amid Automotive Crisis
properties.summary: Denso Thermal Systems in Avellino is facing severe production and employment challenges due to the ongoing automotive sector crisis, leading to significant layoffs. UILM has raised alarms about the situation, urging an immediate meeting with Minister Urso to prevent further deterioration of employment in the region.

properties.title: Denso Revises Profit Forecast Amid Quality Issues and Tariff Impacts
properties.summary: Denso has announced a significant downward revision of its profit forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2026, reducing net profit expectations from 515 billion yen to 497 billion yen. This adjustment is attributed to quality issues that necessitated financial provisions and updated exchange rate assumptions. Despite a reported increase in sales, the company's net profit has seen a drastic decline of 31.2% year-on-year for the second quarter, raising concerns about its financial stability moving forward.

properties.title: Denso Group Data Leak Due to Misconfigured Power BI Access Permissions
properties.summary: Denso Group has revealed a significant data leak incident caused by misconfigured access permissions in its Microsoft Power BI platform, which allowed all employees to view sensitive personal information of their colleagues. The company has since corrected these permissions and is implementing enhanced security measures and employee training to prevent future occurrences. This incident highlights the critical importance of proper data access controls within organizations.

properties.title: Denso Issues Urgent Update for Vulnerable Drive Recorder Installers
properties.summary: Denso has announced a critical vulnerability in its Ten drive recorder viewer installers, identified as CVE-2025-57781, which could allow arbitrary code execution with administrative privileges. The company has released updated installers to address this issue and is urging users to download the latest version to ensure their systems remain secure. This announcement comes amid ongoing scrutiny of Denso's software security practices.

properties.title: Denso Drive Recorder Viewer Installers Found Vulnerable
properties.summary: Denso Issues Update to Address Vulnerability in Drive Recorder Viewer Installers

properties.title: Denso's Investment Rating Cut by SMBC Nikko Securities
properties.summary: Denso Faces Downgrade Amidst Market Concerns

properties.title: Denso's Agricultural Acquisition Triggers Investment Rating Downgrade Amid Concerns Over Strategic Shift
properties.summary: Denso's recent acquisition of a Dutch seed company for over 730 billion yen has led to a downgrade in its investment rating by SMBC Nikko Securities, which has reduced its target price from 2,700 yen to 2,200 yen. This marks a significant shift for Denso as it diversifies from its core automotive business, raising concerns about the potential impact on its existing operations and stock performance.

properties.title: Denso Faces Downgrade Amid M&A Strategy Scrutiny
properties.summary: Denso is under fire as SMBC Nikko Securities has downgraded its investment rating, raising concerns about the company's mergers and acquisitions strategy. Analysts are questioning Denso's ability to effectively utilize its significant cash reserves to create synergies from its acquisitions, prompting a call for clearer communication regarding its future M&A plans.

properties.title: Denso's Stock Plummets Amid Toyota Production Cuts and Downgraded Ratings
properties.summary: Denso faces a financial crisis as its stock prices drop nearly 5% following Toyota's announcement of a 40% reduction in global production for September. Mizuho Securities has downgraded Denso's stock price target, highlighting concerns about the company's future performance despite expectations of record profits. The situation has led to a loss of investor confidence, with multiple securities firms adjusting their ratings amid a challenging automotive supply industry.

properties.title: Mizuho Lowers Denso Stock Price Target Amidst Production Challenges
properties.summary: Mizuho Securities has revised its target stock price for Denso, reducing it from 2,700 yen to 2,400 yen due to ongoing challenges such as decreased auto production and quality costs. Despite these setbacks, Mizuho remains optimistic, projecting record-high profits and an increase in return on equity (ROE) for Denso, maintaining a 'buy' rating on the stock.

properties.title: Denso Corp. Faces Cybersecurity Crisis Following Ransomware Attack by 'Pandora'
properties.summary: Denso Corp. faces escalating cybersecurity challenges following a ransomware attack attributed to the criminal group 'Pandora', which resulted in the theft of over 1.1 terabytes of sensitive data from its German facility. The breach has raised serious concerns about the company's data protection measures and operational integrity, prompting Denso to enhance its cybersecurity protocols in response to the ongoing threats.

properties.title: Pandora Group Claims Responsibility for Cyber Attack
properties.summary: A cybercriminal group known as 'Pandora' has taken responsibility for a recent cyber attack, revealing their involvement through a statement posted on the dark web. This information was disclosed by Mitsui Bussan Secure Direction, shedding light on the identity of the perpetrators behind the incident.

properties.title: Denso Faces Workforce Cuts and Transportation Service Elimination Amid Strikes and Economic Concerns
properties.summary: Denso is facing mounting challenges as it continues to reduce its workforce, with 243 employees laid off in 2023 and an additional 180 potentially leaving through a pension scheme. The company has also eliminated transportation services for employees, exacerbating the difficulties for workers amid ongoing strikes for better job security and investment in electric vehicle production. With 800 families impacted by these decisions, the future of the San Salvo facility remains uncertain, raising concerns about the local economy.

properties.title: Denso Cuts Bus Service Amid Job Losses in Poirino
properties.summary: Following the recent job cuts at Denso in Poirino, the company has taken an additional step by discontinuing the bus service for employees who are no longer eligible for transportation benefits. This decision impacts workers who have managed to retain their positions through wage supplementation or other incentives, raising concerns about their commuting options and overall job security.

properties.title: Denso Workers Strike Over Job Security Amid Controversy Over Holiday Work Request
properties.summary: Denso faces backlash as 52 workers in Piedimonte San Germano strike over the company's lack of a clear job security plan and insufficient engagement with labor unions. The strike, sparked by Denso's request for employees to work on February 14, highlights the urgent concerns of workers amid uncertainties in the automotive sector, contradicting the company's previous assurances regarding job stability and diversification efforts.

properties.title: Denso Faces Financial Threats from New U.S. Tariffs Despite Record Profits
properties.summary: Denso, despite achieving its highest profits in seven years, is facing significant challenges due to new U.S. tariffs on its electric vehicle products. This situation highlights the potential financial instability and operational hurdles the company may encounter as it navigates the evolving trade landscape in the automotive sector.

properties.title: Denso Achieves Record Profit Amidst New Tariff Challenges
properties.summary: Denso reports a record-high consolidated net profit of 419 billion yen for the fiscal year ending March 2025, marking a 34.0% increase from the previous year, driven by strong sales in electrification products and ADAS. However, the company now faces challenges due to the impact of high U.S. tariffs imposed during the Trump administration, which could affect future profitability.

properties.title: Trump Considers Tariff Exemption Impacting Denso
properties.summary: US President Trump is contemplating a temporary exemption from automobile tariffs, which could significantly impact Denso's operations and lead to favorable market trends for parts imports. This potential policy shift has sparked interest in the automotive sector, particularly for companies like Denso that are closely tied to tariff regulations.

properties.title: Denso Faces Class Action Lawsuit and Labor Scrutiny Amid Price-Fixing Allegations
properties.summary: Denso is facing a class action lawsuit in Canada for alleged price-fixing in the automotive parts sector, impacting numerous purchasers. The company is also under scrutiny for its treatment of temporary workers in Japan, with claims of poor working conditions. In response to these challenges, Denso has reaffirmed its commitment to legal compliance and fostering a collaborative workplace, while also addressing the need for accountability in its labor practices.

properties.title: Denso Secures 30 Billion Yen Investment from MS&AD Insurance Group
properties.summary: Denso Secures Major Investment Amidst Ongoing Scrutiny

properties.title: Denso Reveals Role in Solar Power Facility Amid Controversy
properties.summary: Denso has disclosed its role as the main tenant of a solar power facility in Taira City, Niigata Prefecture, which was not mentioned in its previous quarterly report. This omission led to the facility's inability to harness solar energy during essential replacement work from January 28 to 30. The company has now issued a Securities Report to clarify its involvement in the solar power contract.

properties.title: Joint Protest Announced in Support of Dismissed Denso Workers
properties.summary: A joint protest is set to take place on March 12 in front of the Denso plant in Avellino, organized by Crescenzo Auriemma of Uilm Napoli and Campania alongside Cgil and Cisl. This demonstration aims to express solidarity with the workers who have been dismissed and to challenge the company's recent decisions.

properties.title: Union Leaders Reject Strike to Protect Jobs and Investment
properties.summary: The provincial union secretaries and RSU representatives have explicitly rejected the proposed 8-hour strike, citing concerns over the potential loss of 200 jobs and a significant investment of 20 million euros. They are advocating for dialogue as a means to resolve the conflict instead of resorting to strikes.

properties.title: Denso Stabilizes 73 Workers with Promise of More Jobs
properties.summary: Denso Thermal System has announced the stabilization of 73 workers into permanent positions, including 7 who were previously laid off. This move is accompanied by a commitment to create an additional 50 permanent jobs by 2025, marking a significant step towards recovery after recent job insecurities.

properties.title: Denso's Holiday Work Request Sparks Union Backlash Amid Automotive Sector Struggles
properties.summary: Denso faces significant backlash from labor unions, including Fiom and Uilm, for requesting employees to work on February 14, a public holiday, under a solidarity contract. This request has sparked intense criticism and highlighted the ongoing challenges in the automotive sector, as unions point out the irony of their previous criticisms towards the Ugl union's actions. The situation has escalated tensions between Denso and labor representatives, raising concerns about labor practices during this economically challenging time.
